description: Use this when the person asks which of their own products lack a safety data sheet, a declaration of performance or any document. Lists the products of the connected account that have a gap, with the same definitions as the open items of the dashboard overview: no document at all (no-document), no safety data sheet and no declaration of performance or conformity (no-sdb), no declaration of performance while other products have one (no-dop), a current safety data sheet older than three years (sdb-old), a current document without a revision date (undated). Products that are not public are left out. Optionally only one gap; 25 per page by default. Uploading is done in the dashboard; the tool returns the link to the filtered product list. Do not use for documents that exist but are old (use list_documents_due) or to upload anything; uploading is done in the dashboard.

gap.description: Only this gap: no-document, no-sdb, no-dop, sdb-old, undated; default any

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: list_missing_documents
title: Products with missing documents
